# Results {#sec-results}

## Participant characteristics

Baseline characteristics were balanced between groups (@tbl-baseline).

| Characteristic | Intervention (n = 31) | Control (n = 31) |
|:---|---:|---:|
| Age (years) | 71.2 (4.1) | 70.8 (4.4) |
| Women, n (%) | 17 (55) | 16 (52) |
| BMI (kg/m²) | 26.4 (3.2) | 26.9 (3.6) |
| V̇O~2peak~ (mL·kg⁻¹·min⁻¹) | 24.1 (4.8) | 24.6 (5.1) |

: Baseline characteristics. Values are mean (SD) unless stated otherwise. {#tbl-baseline}

## Primary outcome

Peak oxygen uptake increased by 2.4 mL·kg⁻¹·min⁻¹ (95% CI 1.6 to 3.2) in the
intervention group relative to control.

## Secondary outcomes

Changes in cardiometabolic markers were small and are summarised in
@tbl-secondary.

| Outcome | Difference (95% CI) |
|:---|:---|
| Systolic blood pressure (mmHg) | −3.1 (−6.4 to 0.2) |
| Fasting glucose (mmol/L) | −0.09 (−0.24 to 0.06) |
| Waist circumference (cm) | −1.4 (−2.8 to −0.1) |

: Between-group differences in secondary outcomes at week 12. {#tbl-secondary}
